en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with low, mostly two‑storey houses with tiled roofs scattered on gentle hills, separated by trees and vegetation in the foreground. Across the top half of the image there is dense handwritten text in purple ink. Printed captions in French and Greek identify the view, and a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom right.
